definitions.explanation: An acute viral infectious disease spread by mosquitoes, occurring in tropical regions of Africa and South America. Causes high fever, jaundice (hence the "yellow" in the name), bleeding, and in severe cases organ failure. Travelers to endemic areas are often required to show proof of vaccination.

examples.japanese: {黄熱病|おうねつびょう}のワクチンを{打|う}った。
examples.english: I got a yellow fever vaccine.

examples.japanese: アフリカでは{今|いま}も{黄熱病|おうねつびょう}が{流行|りゅうこう}している。
examples.english: Yellow fever is still prevalent in Africa.

examples.japanese: {入国|にゅうこく}の{際|さい}に{黄熱病|おうねつびょう}の{予防|よぼう}{接種|せっしゅ}{証明書|しょうめいしょ}が{必要|ひつよう}な{国|くに}もある。
examples.english: There are countries where a yellow fever vaccination certificate is required when entering.

examples.japanese: {野口|のぐち}{英世|ひでよ}は{黄熱病|おうねつびょう}の{研究|けんきゅう}{中|ちゅう}、{自身|じしん}も{感染|かんせん}して{命|いのち}を{落|お}とした。
examples.english: Noguchi Hideyo contracted yellow fever himself while researching the disease, and lost his life.

notes:
Composed of {黄|おう} (yellow) + {熱|ねつ} (fever) + -{病|びょう} (disease). The name is a calque of the English "yellow fever": the "yellow" refers to the jaundice that appears in severe cases when the virus damages the liver.

USAGE:
Primarily appears in public-health news, travel medicine, and history. In Japan, the word is especially associated with the bacteriologist {野口|のぐち}{英世|ひでよ} (1876-1928), who investigated yellow fever in West Africa and died of the disease there; his portrait appeared on the 1,000-yen note from 2004 to 2024.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {黄熱病|おうねつびょう}にかかる: to catch yellow fever
- {黄熱病|おうねつびょう}の{予防|よぼう}{接種|せっしゅ}: yellow fever vaccination
- {黄熱病|おうねつびょう}ワクチン: yellow fever vaccine
- {黄熱病|おうねつびょう}{流行|りゅうこう}{地域|ちいき}: yellow-fever endemic area
- {黄熱病|おうねつびょう}の{研究|けんきゅう}: yellow-fever research

SIMILAR WORDS:
- デング{熱|ねつ}: dengue fever — another mosquito-borne viral fever, more widespread in Asia
- マラリア: malaria — a mosquito-borne parasitic disease, not viral
- ジカ{熱|ねつ}: Zika fever — a different mosquito-borne viral disease
- {感染症|かんせんしょう}: infectious disease — the general category
- {風土|ふうど}{病|びょう}: endemic disease — a disease characteristic of a particular region
